title: A 410-mW 1.22-GHz Downconverter in a Dual-Conversion Tuner IC for OpenCable Applications
type: 410-mW 1.22-GHz Downconverter in a Dual-Conversion Tuner IC
function_summary: 410-mW 1.22-GHz Downconverter in a Dual-Conversion Tuner IC: The desired channel is first upconverted utilizes a trifilar transformer in conjunction with capacitively to a fixed IF of 1220 MHz, where partial channel selection and cross-coupled common-gate mixer input stages to achieve a large image rejection are performed with a SAW filter.
warnings: Small score margin between the top figure candidates; manual confirmation recommended.
